snippet.title: Nightwatch at the Hopkins' Cliffside | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi, I’m Krzysztof Grzelak, the sole developer of this game, and I’m excited to share this trailer with you!

About the Game:

Immerse yourself in a first-person thriller horror game inspired by "observation on duty" games mechanics. Armed with a mysterious artifact, your task is to detect reality-bending anomalies and survive the night as relentless entities hunt you.
There are dozens of anomalies, each with their own spawn possibilities. As you search for them, you’re free to explore both inside and outside the house— but beware, nowhere is truly safe.

I’m aiming to finish the game by the end of this year, as most major mechanics are already in place! However, please note that some elements shown in the trailer may change in the final version.

When you wishlist the game I'll know how many people are waiting for it! So please go and check out the Steam store page with the link right below.

• Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3121630/Nightwatch_at_the_Hopkins_Cliffside/
